name: infected-voices-mobile
description: Infected Voices native iPhone/iPad app using the Core 5 studio engine with the guarded Core 6 collaboration client

scripts.native:ios: npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-native.mjs ios
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync:ios && npx cap open ios
